name: Malicious Link
description: An adversary may rely upon a user clicking a malicious link in order to gain execution. Users may be subjected to social engineering to get them to click on a link that will lead to code execution. This user action will typically be observed as follow-on behavior from [Spearphishing Link](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566/002). Clicking on a link may also lead to other execution techniques such as exploitation of a browser or application vulnerability via [Exploitation for Client Execution](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1203). Links may also lead users to download files that require execution via [Malicious File](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1204/002).

telemetry.name: File Creation
telemetry.description: Creation or overwrite of a file at an observed path.
telemetry.collection_focus: Scope Sysmon FileCreate (11) to the lab directory; retain the process and file path. Differentiate creation/overwrite if the sensor can.

For Linux or macOS, select the equivalent sensor separately and test its emitted fields; a Windows event ID does not transfer across platforms.

telemetry.limitations: Event filtering and sensor versions change coverage. High-volume image-load and process-access collection needs tuning; endpoint events alone do not establish intent.

telemetry.collection_focus: Scope approved packet capture/protocol content collection to the lab flow; retain capture provenance and truncation indicators.

configuration: Use an authorized lab TAP/SPAN, virtual mirror or gateway interface. Define which traffic crosses it; avoid assuming visibility into every segment.
Enable the required Zeek analyzers or Suricata EVE event types. Export logs with sensor identity, clock synchronization and flow correlation identifiers.
Monitor capture loss, truncation and exporter sampling. Capture payload only with approval and restrictive retention; encryption normally prevents plaintext inspection.
telemetry.example_note: Project-normalized synthetic JSON, not a native provider log, captured event, attack verdict or validated detection. A parser/adapter is required for a real SIEM. Example names, IPs and values are fictional.
telemetry.limitations: Flows are not packet payloads. NAT, asymmetric routes, encryption, missing mirrors and sampling can hide attribution or content. A destination connection alone does not prove malicious intent.
telemetry.anomaly_design: Per source and observation point: connection rate, destination-host/port fan-out, response/failure ratio and previously unseen destinations. Compare equivalent time windows; separate authorized scanners, NAT and sampling effects.

strategies.name: User Execution – Malicious Link (click → suspicious egress → download/write → follow-on activity)

analytics.name: Analytic 0178
analytics.guidance: Behavioral chain: (1) a user-facing app (browser/Office/email client) launches a URL or handles a link, then (2) the same process lineage makes an outbound connection to an untrusted domain/IP, (3) a file is downloaded or unpacked to a user-writable location shortly after the click. Optional enrichment: subsequent child execution by LOLBINs.

tuning.description: Correlation window (e.g., 15m) between link click / first egress / file write.
Processes considered link sources: chrome.exe, msedge.exe, firefox.exe, winword.exe, outlook.exe, teams.exe.
User-writable directories to monitor (%USERPROFILE%\Downloads, %TEMP%, %APPDATA%\*, OneDrive caches).
High-risk TLD and domain list (e.g., .top .xyz .monster; newly observed domains/NOD).
Corporate CDNs/update hosts to reduce false positives.

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Suspicious URL patterns, uncommon TLDs, short-lived domains, URL shorteners; HTTP method GET/POST

analytics.name: Analytic 0179
analytics.guidance: Behavioral chain: (1) browser/office/GUI mail client opens a URL, (2) outbound connection to untrusted domain, (3) a new file is saved in $HOME/Downloads, /tmp, or cache immediately after.

tuning.description: exe, elf, sh, js, py, jar, iso, img, zip, rar, xlsm, docm, xll.
Heuristic or TI score threshold for domains.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: execve: Execs of chromium, google-chrome, firefox, libreoffice with http(s) in cmdline

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: open,creat,rename: Writes in $HOME/Downloads, /tmp, ~/.cache with exe/script/archive/office extensions

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Suspicious URL patterns, uncommon TLDs, URL shorteners

analytics.name: Analytic 0180
analytics.guidance: Behavioral chain: (1) Safari/Chrome/Firefox/Office handles a URL; unified logs show open/click or LSQuarantine assignment, (2) outbound connection to untrusted domain, (3) a new file appears in ~/Downloads or /private/var/folders/* with quarantine flag.

tuning.description: Alert when com.apple.quarantine missing on newly downloaded executables.

log_sources.name: fs:fsevents
log_sources.channel: Create in /Users/*/Downloads or /private/var/folders/* with quarantine attribute

mitigations.name: User Training
mitigations.description: Use user training as a way to bring awareness to common phishing and spearphishing techniques and how to raise suspicion for potentially malicious events.

mitigations.name: Restrict Web-Based Content
mitigations.description: If a link is being visited by a user, block unknown or unused files in transit by default that should not be downloaded or by policy from suspicious sites as a best practice to prevent some vectors, such as .scr, .exe, .pif, .cpl, etc. Some download scanning devices can open and analyze compressed and encrypted formats, such as zip and rar that may be used to conceal malicious files.

mitigations.name: Network Intrusion Prevention
mitigations.description: If a link is being visited by a user, network intrusion prevention systems and systems designed to scan and remove malicious downloads can be used to block activity.

simulation.prerequisites: Use disposable lab hosts and test accounts, explicit target allowlists, a clean snapshot, bounded egress and a restore plan. Review every candidate and dependency before any execution.

synthetic.purpose: Collection/parser contract exercise, NOT a positive example or detection of this TTP.
